title: 142nd Global Action: Families March Nearly 12 Years On, Reject CNDH Report
detail: Normalista students and families of the 43 held the 142nd monthly Global Action for Ayotzinapa, marching from the Ángel de la Independencia to the Hemiciclo a Juárez in Mexico City. Parents said they remain 'far from knowing the truth' nearly 12 years after the disappearances. Marchers ratified their rejection of the CNDH's July 9 recommendation exonerating the Army of institutional responsibility and dismissed suggestions of division within the families' movement, presenting a unified front ahead of the case's 12th anniversary in September.
